packageRules.description: Base and tool images are pinned by digest so a rebuild resolves to the same bytes.
knowledge-storm is dormant upstream, last released 2025-01-23. A pin that never moves is expected rather than a stale dependency, so it is not proposed automatically.

sentence-transformers is constrained because upstream leaves it unpinned and the resolver otherwise picks a version incompatible with modern huggingface-hub. Raising it needs the constraint in pyproject.toml checked by hand.
torch comes from the PyTorch CPU index rather than PyPI, and only exists to keep the CUDA runtime out of the image.
